description: Guest room join: a live guest session may join its own open meeting.
precondition: Guest sessions and meetings in known statuses seeded.

cases.inputs: guest: session of this meeting; meetingId: the Published meeting.
preconditions: Guest session is valid and belongs to the meeting; guest invitation is readable.

cases.inputs: guest: valid session; meetingId: InProgress meeting.
preconditions: Meeting is InProgress; guest session valid and readable.

cases.inputs: guest: session with SessionId = empty Guid; meetingId: any meeting.
preconditions: Guest session has an empty SessionId (invalid).
cases.return: false; the meeting is not loaded.

cases.inputs: guest: session of meeting A; meetingId: meeting B.
preconditions: Guest session belongs to another meeting.

cases.inputs: guest: valid session of this meeting; meetingId: the meeting.
preconditions: Guest invitation was revoked so the agenda guest-access check fails.
cases.return: false; the meeting is not loaded.

cases.inputs: guest: valid session; meetingId: deleted meeting id.
guest: valid session; meetingId: Ended meeting.
cases.return: false; only Published and InProgress meetings are open to guests.

cases.inputs: guest: valid session; meetingId: Draft meeting.
